Hand-authored single-cut stereo fixture: 21 small drug-like structures covering a cut-invalidated pseudo stereocentre, surviving tetrahedral centres, retained and re-expressed E/Z geometry, an isotope-labelled centre, and created stereocentres. On created-centre placement: isobutanol_created_frag1 (OCC(C)C) puts the new centre in RDKit fragment 1 for both of its desymmetrising cuts, while ethylbutanol_created_frag2 (CCC(CC)CO) puts it in fragment 2 for cut (1,2) and in fragment 1 for cut (3,2). A fragment-2-only structure cannot exist at one cut: every desymmetrising cut has an automorphic partner cut yielding the same fragment pair with the centre in fragment 1, and mmpdb dedupes on attachment_order.variable_smiles.constant_smiles without the enumeration label, so the partner always restores the row. That is why the accompanying allowlist is empty.

mmpdb 3.1.4 single-cut oracle. Generated with `mmpdb fragment tests/data/mmpdb/stereo_cases.smi --num-cuts 1 -o stereo.fragdb` then `sqlite3 -header -tabs stereo.fragdb "SELECT record.title AS molecule_id, fragmentation.num_cuts, fragmentation.enumeration_label, fragmentation.variable_num_heavies, fragmentation.variable_smiles, fragmentation.attachment_order, fragmentation.constant_num_heavies, fragmentation.constant_smiles, coalesce(fragmentation.constant_with_H_smiles, '') as constant_with_h_smiles FROM fragmentation JOIN record ON record.id = fragmentation.record_id ORDER BY record.title, fragmentation.enumeration_label, fragmentation.variable_smiles, fragmentation.constant_smiles;"`. Complete as generated: no rows were filtered. It contains no `[*][H]` hydrogen fragmentations (mmpdb fragment_algorithm._hydrogen_cut_smiles) because `mmpdb fragment` drives fragment_mol, which never calls get_hydrogen_fragmentations; that absence is pinned structurally by test_oracle_contains_no_hydrogen_cut_rows rather than worked around.
